skills.name: Vicious Implosion

skills.name: Abyssal Wave
skills.description:
Shoots a wave of force up to 20m in front of you. Inflicts 852 (778 + 180% Magic Attack) Magic Damage and knocks back all enemies it touches.
Pushed enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the number of waves. Being struck by multiple waves in a row dramatically decreases enemies' Move Speed.
This skill counts as a Push effect.

skills.name: Crushing Grasp
skills.description:
Creates a powerful gravity vortex around a chosen target after a short delay. Deals 131 (86 + 110% Magic Attack) Magic Damage to all enemies in a 10m radius (15m at Rank 2), pulling them to the target's location, but leaves the initial target unharmed.
Pulled enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description: Creates a gravity vortex around a target dealing 131 (86 + 110% Magic Attack) Magic Damage in a 10m–15m radius, pulling and Staggering surrounding enemies.
